title: from_hex() in tests panics on odd-length input with silent index OOB
description: smime_tests.rs from_hex(): iterates step_by(2) over s.len(); if a hex constant has an odd number of chars (e.g. from copy-paste truncation), the last .step_by(2) step accesses s[i..i+2] where i+2 > s.len() and panics with a byte-index out-of-bounds. The panic message is unhelpful. The function should assert\!(s.len() % 2 == 0, 'hex string must have even length') at entry so the failure points at the malformed constant.
